import java.util.*;

/**
 * Java translation of the GNU C++17 code.
 * The code reads N and K from stdin and outputs the result.
 * The generic Matrix class is specialized for long with mod operations.
 */
public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] A;
        int n, m;

        // Constructors
        public Matrix(int n, int m) {
            this.n = n;
            this.m = m;
            A = new long[n][m];
        }

        public Matrix(int n) {
            this(n, n);
        }

        // Copy constructor
        public Matrix(Matrix other) {
            this.n = other.n;
            this.m = other.m;
            this.A = new long[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(other.A[i], 0, this.A[i], 0, m);
            }
        }

        // Accessors
        long get(int i, int j) { return A[i][j]; }
        void set(int i, int j, long val) { A[i][j] = val; }

        // Identity matrix
        static Matrix I(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                mat.A[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return mat;
        }

        // Arithmetic operations (mod MOD)
        Matrix add(Matrix B) {
            Matrix C = new Matrix(this);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    C.A[i][j] = (C.A[i][j] + B.A[i][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix B) {
            Matrix C = new Matrix(this);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    C.A[i][j] = (C.A[i][j] - B.A[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            int new_n = n, new_m = B.m;
            int p = m;
            Matrix C = new Matrix(new_n, new_m);
            for (int i = 0; i < new_n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < new_m; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        sum = (sum + A[i][k] * B.A[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                    C.A[i][j] = sum;
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        // Equivalent to operator^= (in-place exponentiation)
        Matrix pow(long exp) {
            Matrix result = Matrix.I(n);
            Matrix base = new Matrix(this);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        // rot() as in original code
        void rot() {
            // Only for square matrix of size (K+1) where K is known.
            // Should be called only on matrices with K+1 rows.
            int K = n - 1;  // because size is K+1
            Matrix B = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] = A[(i + K + 1 - 1) % K][(j + K + 1 - 1) % K];  // (i+K-1)%K, but i from 0..K-1, K used as modulus
                }
                B.A[i][K] = A[(i + K + 1 - 1) % K][K];
                B.A[K][i] = A[K][(i + K + 1 - 1) % K];
            }
            B.A[K][K] = A[K][K];
            // Copy B back to this.A
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(B.A[i], 0, this.A[i], 0, m);
            }
        }

        // determinant - not used but kept for completeness
        long determinant() {
            Matrix B = new Matrix(this);
            long ret = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int idx = -1;
                for (int j = i; j < n; j++) {
                    if (B.A[j][i] != 0) { idx = j; break; }
                }
                if (idx == -1) return 0;
                if (i != idx) {
                    ret = -ret;
                    long[] tmp = B.A[i];
                    B.A[i] = B.A[idx];
                    B.A[idx] = tmp;
                }
                ret *= B.A[i][i];
                long vv = B.A[i][i];
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] /= vv;
                }
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    long a = B.A[j][i];
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        B.A[j][k] -= B.A[i][k] * a;
                    }
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                sb.append("[");
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    sb.append(A[i][j]);
                    if (j + 1 == m) sb.append("]\n");
                    else sb.append(",");
                }
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }
    }

    static long beki(long a, long b) {
        if (b == 0) return 1;
        long ret = beki(a, b / 2);
        ret = ret * ret;
        if ((b & 1) == 1) ret *= a;
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        int K = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        int INDEX = 0;
        long copy = N;
        while (copy >= K) {
            INDEX++;
            copy /= K;
        }

        // Matrix array: mat[index][rotation]
        Matrix[][] mat = new Matrix[70][35];

        // Initialize mat[0][0]
        mat[0][0] = Matrix.I(K + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < K + 1; i++) {
            mat[0][0].set(0, i, 1);
        }

        // Precompute rotations for index 0
        for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
            mat[0][i] = new Matrix(mat[0][i - 1]); // copy
            mat[0][i].rot();
        }

        // Precompute higher indices
        for (int index = 1; index <= INDEX; index++) {
            mat[index][0] = new Matrix(mat[index - 1][0]);
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][0] = mat[index - 1][i].multiply(mat[index][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][i] = new Matrix(mat[index][i - 1]);
                mat[index][i].rot();
            }
        }

        // ans = (K+1) x 1 column matrix
        Matrix ans = new Matrix(K + 1, 1);
        ans.set(K, 0, 1);
        int used = 0;

        while (INDEX >= 0) {
            long powVal = beki(K, INDEX);
            // In the original code, the for loop runs with i from 0 upwards,
            // but i is not used; only used to count consecutive subtractions.
            // However the condition if(powVal <= N) is inside the for, and
            // when fails, break. So we replicate with while loop.
            while (powVal <= N) {
                N -= powVal;
                ans = mat[INDEX][used].multiply(ans);
                used = (used + 1) % K;
            }
            INDEX--;
        }

        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; i++) {
            val = (val + ans.get(i, 0)) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(val);
    }
}
